verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fetalai mai foi le ALII ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded, saying,
verses.sm: Ina fai ane ia ia Arona, ma ona atalii, atoa ma le fanauga uma a Isaraelu, ia faapea ane ia i latou, O lenei le mea ua poloai mai ai le ALII, ua faapea mai.

verses.en: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,
verses.sm: Ai se tagata o le aiga o Isaraelu, na te fasi se povi poa, po O se tamai mamoe, po o se ‘oti, i le toagalauapi, pe fasi i tua O le toagalauapi;

verses.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the LORD before the tabernacle of the LORD; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
verses.sm: a ua le aumaia i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o lc faapotopotoga e avatu ai le taulaga i le Aw i luma o le malumalu o le ALTI, e taʻua lea tagata o le faa177 maligi toto; ua faamaligiina e ia le toto; e vavaeeseina lea tagata i lona nuu,

verses.en: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the LORD, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto the LORD.
verses.sm: ina ia aumaia e le fanauga a Isaraelu a latou taulaga latou te fai taulaga ai i le vao, ia latou aumaia lava i le Aw i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga i le faitaulaga; latou te fai taulaga ai, o taulaga faafetai i le Ann.

verses.en: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.sm: E sausauina foi e le faitaulaga le toto i luga o le fata faitaulaga o le ALII i le faitotoa O le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga, e susunu foi le ga'o e fai ma mea manogi lelei i le ALII.

verses.en: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
verses.sm: Latou te le toe faia foi a latou taulaga i aitu, sa latou mulimuli atu ai e mulilulua ai; o le tulafono lena e faavavau ia i latou i o latou tupulaga amuli.

verses.en: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,
verses.sm: E te fai ane foi ia i latou, Ai se tagata o sa Isaraelú, po o so o se tagata ese e aumau ia te i latou, na te faia se taulaga mu, po o se isi taulaga,

verses.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the LORD; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.sm: a e le aumaia i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga e sauni ai i le ALII; e vavaeeseina lava lea tagata i lona nuu.

verses.en: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.sm: Ai se tagata foi o sa Isaraelù, po o so O se tagata ese ua āumau ia te i latou, na te “aina sina toto lava; ou te fai mo'u fili lea tagata na te “aina le toto, ma ou vavae ese ia te ia i lona nuu.

verses.en: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
verses.sm: Aua o i le toto le ola o le tino; ua ou tuuina atu ai foi ia te outou e fai ai le togiola mo outou i luga o le fata faitaulaga; aua o le toto o le mea lava lea e fai afi le togiola mo le tagata.

verses.en: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
verses.sm: O le mea lava lea na ou fai atu ai i le fanauga a Isaraelu, Aua le ‘aina ni toto e so outou, aua le ‘aina foi le toto e se tagata ese e aumau ia te outou.

verses.en: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
verses.sm: Ai se tagata foi o le fanauga a Isaraelu, po o so O se tagata ese ua āumau ia te i latou, na te tulia se manu o le vao, po o se manu lele e “aina; ia faamasaaina lava e ia lona toto, ma ufiufi ai i le eleele.

verses.en: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
verses.sm: Aua o le ola lea o mea ola uma; o lo latou toto, o lo latou ola lava lea; o le mea lava lea na ou fai atu ai i le fanauga a Isaraelu, Aua tou te aai i le toto o se mea Ola; aua o le ola o mea uma o lo latou toto lava lea; ai se ‘ai ai e vavaeeseina o ia.

verses.en: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
verses.sm: Ai se tagata foi ua ‘ai ise mea ua mate, po O se mea ua saeia, o se tama a le eleele, po o se tagata ese, na te taia ona ofu, ma taele i le vai, e leaga foi o ia seia oo i le afiafi; ona mama ai lea.

verses.en: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.sm: A e afai na te le taia ona ofu, ma ua le taele lona tino, ona nofo sala lava lea o ia.
